scientific_integrity: Proof reconstructs positive mixed-resolvent interval coefficients and derives all-size uniqueness. Finite checks are supplemental, not a substitute for the proof. No assertion of independent validation or definitive publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Only exact trace evaluation by independent class-supported Rademacher probes; all path conductances and killing rates strictly positive; homogeneous variance density uses fixed k and fixed positive screening. No claim about coupled signs or cost-aware matrix-function approximations.
title: Variance-optimal periodic log-determinant probing on arbitrarily weighted paths
